mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%, the 20-day forward return average is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 9.0% for two consecutive months signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for two consecutive months, 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand that triggers corporate revenue revisions downward, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When both HOUST and RSAFS decline simultaneously, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in industrial production below 95.0 index signals manufacturing supply constraints that increase input costs and reduce corporate output, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods where INDPRO remains below 95.0 for three consecutive months, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPI increase exceeding 3.0% signals accelerating inflation that forces Federal Reserve tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3.0%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained non-farm payroll growth above 100,000 jobs per month indicates strengthening labor markets that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When PAYEMS growth exceeds 100,000, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Slowing GDP growth below 1.5% annualized signals weakening aggregate demand that reduces corporate investment and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In quarters with GDP growth below 1.5% annualized, 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of FEDFUNDS below 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeding 3.0% creates stagflation conditions that depress equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY growth > 3.0%, 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03.
